page0.text:
Her field of view expands.
As soon as she leaves the darkness, Rin Tohsaka forgets that she's underground.

page1.text:
She sees an infinitely high canopy and a black sun.
This massive space is no cave. It's a desolate land.
It's easily two—no, three kilometers in diameter.
A giant monolith stands in the distance.
...It is the beginning of this war, and the end.
Once she climbs that precipice, she should see a giant crater.
Therein lies a system that's been operating for two hundred years.

page2.text: A dark pillar burns inside the bowl of the huge rock containing the giant magic circle called the Greater Grail.

page3.text:
Thump, thump. The black shadow pulsates.
A wave of magical energy leaks out from something within, illuminating the wasteland.
According to the Tohsaka archives, it's called the Altar of the Beginning.
In its very center lies a circular cloister, a heart-world:
the Cup of Heaven.
Pregnant with immeasurable magical energy, it gives rise to an otherworld worthy of its name.

page4.text:
"That's Aŋra Mainiiu... She wasn't kidding when she called it All the Evil in the World..."
Rin makes a light remark as she walks toward the altar.
...She's worried about Shirou and Rider, but her situation isn't much better.
The magical energy filling the Greater Grail isn't in a dimension that humans can do anything about.

page5.text:
It's an effectively inexhaustible vortex of magical energy,
an inexhaustible resource that mages from around the world gather here to use.
A human could never use it all up in their lifetime, and even if there was a limit to it, it's still correct to call it inexhaustible.

page6.text:
"...I guess it is possible. That's definitely a Holy Grail that can grant any wish."
She can feel her resolve starting to break under the premonition of death numbing her limbs, and the overwhelming disparity in combat strength.
But Rin keeps walking, distracting herself with lighthearted quips.

page7.text:
At the moment, she's on her guard against Zouken Matou and Assassin.
To Rin, Sakura Matou isn't an opponent she needs to be cautious of.
She doesn't feel any threat from Sakura, who's lost sight of herself.
In the end, Sakura is Zouken's puppet.
Her greatest foe is Zouken, no doubt.
Any face-off with Sakura will come once the rest of this affair is settled.

page8.text:
"...That's weird. At this rate, I'm actually going to get to the altar."
Zouken wouldn't have allowed an intruder to come this far.
He would have attacked her well before she got this close.
But he's nowhere to be seen, and Rin is almost at the altar.

page9.text:
...
She thinks.
She considers why Zouken hasn't stopped her, and the fact that she hasn't sensed him or Assassin at all.
Rin takes her observations and makes a deduction.
She wants to deny it, but her mind goes easily to that conclusion.
No, she has no choice but to accept it.
Because...

page10.text: "I'm so happy you're here, Nee-san. You didn't run away."

page11.text: Her deduction is now unmistakable fact.

page12.text:
She looks up.
On top of the high cliff, in front of a black sun,
Sakura Matou welcomes her sister.

page13.text:
"...Ngh."
Rin takes a slight step back, overwhelmed by Sakura's sheer gravity.
...Her transformation is more than anything Rin expected.
Aŋra Mainiiu is a Servant with no definite form.
It's nothing more than a shadow incarnated by human wishes, modeled after human fantasies.
Thus, its power is granted to the host and Master who will give birth to it.

page14.text:
At this very moment, Sakura Matou is Aŋra Mainiiu.
She now serves the function of taking the curse of All the Evil in the World, giving it direction and spilling it into the world.

page15.text:
"...Oh, crap. If Kirei was here, he'd probably call her an agent of God...."
Looking up at Sakura who has become endless magical energy, Rin unseals the Jeweled Sword.
But is this something she can even fight?

page16.text:
Weapons which support magecraft and Mystic Codes which support rituals are broadly divided into two categories.
The first type are Amplifying Functions.
These are backup fuel sources that amplify or replenish a mage's energy, or enhance their magecraft.
They are treated as orthodox support Mystic Codes, and any mage owns at least one. Rin's jewels fall into this category.

page17.text:
The second type are Limited Functions.
Special magical implements, where the weapon is magecraft itself.
They are powered by a mage's magical energy, and enact a pre-defined Mystic.
Their greatest advantage is that a user can execute magecraft that they personally can't perform, as long as they have magical energy.

page18.text:
Limited Functions may not be versatile and restricted to a single purpose, but they have accordingly powerful effects.
For example, a spear which always pierces the heart,
a bridle which can control a Divine Beast,
or a dagger that cancels out all magical effects.
Most Noble Phantasms are classified as Limited Functions.

page19.text:
...
And which type does Rin's Jeweled Sword fall into?
Is it an Amplifying Function which grants its user magical energy,
or a Limited Function which defeats the enemy with a unique ability?
Still...
No matter what it is, she doesn't feel like it'll work against Sakura.

page20.text:
There is an overwhelming disparity in power.
Sakura could probably blow away any magecraft without even trying.

page21.text:
"What's wrong, Nee-san? You look so scared... Hehe, don't tell me you're losing your nerve after coming all this way."
"...Quite the mouth on you now. How about you? What's a crybaby like you going to do without your guardian by your side?"
"..."
The air freezes.
The lukewarm vitality that fills the cave becomes tinged with dark bloodlust.

page22.text:
...
The dark girl bites her lip slightly and sighs.
"Grandfather is gone now. He got in my way, so I crushed him and Assassin."
She giggles and smiles elegantly.

page23.text:
"..."
She didn't even need to ask.
Sakura killed Zouken.
Of course he wouldn't show up.
In the very end, the old mage was eaten by his own pet dog.

page24.text:
"I see. So you're free now. For better or worse, Zouken was the person controlling you.
You broke your own chains, so you have nothing to be afraid of anymore."
"No. I'm not finished yet, Nee-san.
It isn't enough to get rid of Grandfather. I've gotten so strong and I can do anything now, but I'm still not free."

page25.text:
"...You're so insignificant to me now, but you won't disappear from inside of me. You're always in there, mocking me.
So I'll never be free as long as you're here."

page26.text:
Her voice is light and singsong, yet heavy and sticky.
The contradiction proves that she's insane.
In fact, the bloodlust filling the cavern is madness tinged with arrogance and awe.

page27.text:
"Oh, yeah? You seem to be in a pretty good mood despite everything. You killed Zouken, killed Assassin, and it sounds like you even killed Kirei.
Very well done, considering how much you were against it before. Have you gotten used to murder yet?"

page28.text:
"Yes. After all, crushing people isn't any different from swallowing them.
Humans live such boring, pointless lives before I play with them. And I get thirsty, too.
See? I'm just like you, Nee-san. I'm just doing what everyone else does."

page29.text:
"Wait, do you seriously believe that sophistry?"
"It isn't sophistry. I'm not wrong.
The only thing that's changed is that I'm stronger now. I'm strong, so I live my life a different way."

page30.text:
"I'm...I'm stronger now. I'm allowed to do anything now that I'm strong.
...Yeah. As long as I'm strong and I don't lose to anyone, I'll be forgiven for everything I've done. If I'm not myself anymore, then I can say that it was all completely natural, that I had no choice...!"

page31.text:
She screams in rage.
It's the sobbing whine of a child who has nothing else to believe in.

page32.text:
"Get it now, Nee-san? That's who I'll be. So I can kill anyone now. It's perfectly normal to me now."
"...Okay. So you're going to take your anger out on anyone you see. But what about Shirou? He still thinks that he can save you. Are you going murder him, too?"

page33.text:
"Ngh..."
The girl's face twitches.
Rin's question was the last barrier.
...Her ecstasy begins to recede.
Hearing that the boy is so near at hand, the girl manages to reel in her mind that she'd nearly let go of.

page34.text:
Then, she smiles gently.
"Yes. Senpai is no exception.
Actually, he's the only person I really want to kill, Nee-san.
Yeah... I..."

page35.text: ...I want to hurry up and swallow Senpai.

page36.text:
...
Sakura's answer is too late, in every sense of the word.
Rin grips the Jeweled Sword, calculating the distance to the enemy above her.

page37.text:
"...Hmph. What was all that you said about taking Aŋra Mainiiu down with you?
I thought you were stupid, but not this stupid. You've completely let it take you over. You've stopped being human."
The hostility is plain in Rin's voice.
As the administrator of these lands, she has identified her sister as evil.

page38.text:
"...Heh. You're just playing tough. Be honest, Nee-san.
You're actually jealous of my power, aren't you? You envy me. That's why you came to kill me even though you know you can't win.
...Yeah. You want to take this child away from me to make yourself happy."

page39.text:
A shadow rises.
It's a cluster of magical energy unlike any before, a power of Absorption rivalling a Servant's Noble Phantasm.
And not just one—more rear up, one after another.

page40.text:
"I won't let you have it. This is my power. All I'll give you is regret and despair.
I'll teach you...nice and slow."
Four shadows tower over them.
They reach for the girl below, like giant protectors.

page41.text:
"I'll show you the difference in our powers, Nee-san.
No one's coming to save you this time. Drown in the Cup of Heaven, like a bug fallen into a lake."
A shadow giant approaches.
Rin Tohsaka is swallowed by a massive power that can't be dodged or blocked.
